info.title: Union Link API
info.description: Phase one documents five public Launcher read endpoints. Client automation, administration and authentication endpoints are outside this specification. API route v1, muapack formatVersion and the document version are separate concepts. Examples, code generation and test requests are limited to the declared scope.

servers.description: Current site. Local, preview and production deployments use their own same-origin API.

tags.name: Launcher
tags.description: Server discovery, release manifests and download links. No login is required; the backend checks public resource eligibility on every request.

SessionCookie.name: mua_session
SessionCookie.description: Administration uses an HttpOnly session cookie; writes also require a same-origin Origin header. Establish browser sessions through login rather than manually entering cookies.

ApiToken.description: Client automation uses Bearer mua_... tokens, not JWTs. Tokens are restricted by server scope, permissions, expiry and the account's current RBAC. They do not authenticate administration endpoints.

get.description: Returns listed, unarchived servers with a valid bound release, ordered by sortOrder and serverId. Display windows include their start and exclude their end. Expiry hides directory entries only; manifests, downloads and refreshes for otherwise online resources remain available. Times are ISO 8601 strings with a timezone.

200.description: Public server directory. When no servers are visible, servers is [].

500.description: The service or database is temporarily unavailable.

get.summary: Get the original current release manifest
get.description: Returns sealed original JSON bytes in their signed encoding; do not reserialize before signature verification. v1 returns the legacy mua-client-manifest, whose digest is not the package's platform manifest digest. v2 returns mua-recipe-manifest. Obtain the public key through a trusted channel; a response key ID does not establish trust.

200.description: Original release manifest with Ed25519 signature headers.

X-MUA-Manifest-Sha256.description: SHA-256 of the original response bytes.

X-MUA-Signature.description: Release manifest signature, distinct from the independent signature of mua-pack.json inside the archive.

400.description: Invalid parameter format, or a base manifest digest without a base release ID.

404.description: The resource is not public, has been archived, deleted or unbound, or the required file/platform artifact is unavailable.

415.description: The current release format is not accepted by acceptedFormatVersions. No historical release is selected automatically.

500.description: The service or database is temporarily unavailable.

503.description: The published manifest, base or storage artifact is unreadable, or identity, size or digest validation failed.

get.summary: Get a file link from a legacy v1 manifest
get.description: Only supports CAS files in the current v1 release. This endpoint reads the manifest with the default accepted format v1 and returns 415 for a current v2 release; acceptedFormatVersions cannot override this. Invalid file digests and files outside the current release return 404. Returns a JSON link, not file bytes; links normally expire after 300 seconds.

404.description: The resource is not public, has been archived, deleted or unbound, or the required file/platform artifact is unavailable.

415.description: The current release format is not accepted by acceptedFormatVersions. No historical release is selected automatically.

500.description: The service or database is temporarily unavailable.

get.summary: Discover a full or update package for the current release
get.description:
v1 requires one of the six canonical platforms. New v2 protocolRevision:2 needs no platform and ignores any supplied platform value. Historical v2 accepts an omitted platform, universal, or a canonical platform in its original declaration. These rules do not certify game launch compatibility.

Omitting acceptedFormatVersions accepts only v1. Supported values are 1, 2, 1,2 and 2,1. baseReleaseId must match the published base fixed at upload time; providing baseManifestSha256 is recommended. A mismatch falls back to full for the same target. The v1 base digest is the package's platform manifest digest; v2 uses the original recipe manifest digest. Corrupt bases fail explicitly.

Returns a JSON download descriptor, not ZIP bytes. full always points to the complete package for the same target. Links normally expire after 300 seconds. etag is the original S3 value, including quotes, or null; it is not SHA-256. Use the relative refreshUrl to renew links. Storage GET supports a single Range and If-Match; browsers still require storage CORS. Verify size, SHA-256 and archive signatures after download. Do not modify signed URLs or use a GET URL for HEAD.

200.description: A full/update download descriptor for v1, new v2 or historical v2.

400.description: Invalid parameter format, or a base manifest digest without a base release ID.

404.description: The resource is not public, has been archived, deleted or unbound, or the required file/platform artifact is unavailable.

415.description: The current release format is not accepted by acceptedFormatVersions. No historical release is selected automatically.

500.description: The service or database is temporarily unavailable.

503.description: The published manifest, base or storage artifact is unreadable, or identity, size or digest validation failed.

get.summary: Refresh download links for a fixed release
get.description:
v1 requires one of the six canonical platforms. New v2 protocolRevision:2 needs no platform and ignores any supplied platform value. Historical v2 accepts an omitted platform, universal, or a canonical platform in its original declaration. These rules do not certify game launch compatibility.

Omitting acceptedFormatVersions accepts only v1. Supported values are 1, 2, 1,2 and 2,1. baseReleaseId must match the published base fixed at upload time; providing baseManifestSha256 is recommended. A mismatch falls back to full for the same target. The v1 base digest is the package's platform manifest digest; v2 uses the original recipe manifest digest. Corrupt bases fail explicitly.

Returns a JSON download descriptor, not ZIP bytes. full always points to the complete package for the same target. Links normally expire after 300 seconds. etag is the original S3 value, including quotes, or null; it is not SHA-256. Use the relative refreshUrl to renew links. Storage GET supports a single Range and If-Match; browsers still require storage CORS. Verify size, SHA-256 and archive signatures after download. Do not modify signed URLs or use a GET URL for HEAD.

releaseId identifies an unarchived release of the currently online bound client. Historical releases of that client can be refreshed without selecting the latest release. packageSha256 is optional but is always included in generated refreshUrl values; a mismatch returns 409. Archival or unbinding blocks new refreshes, but previously signed links may remain usable until expiry.

200.description: A full/update download descriptor for v1, new v2 or historical v2.

400.description: Invalid parameter format, or a base manifest digest without a base release ID.

404.description: The resource is not public, has been archived, deleted or unbound, or the required file/platform artifact is unavailable.

409.description: The fixed package digest no longer matches. Start a new download task; do not resume with different bytes.

415.description: The current release format is not accepted by acceptedFormatVersions. No historical release is selected automatically.

500.description: The service or database is temporarily unavailable.

503.description: The published manifest, base or storage artifact is unreadable, or identity, size or digest validation failed.
